courseName: AAI Junior Executive (Common Cadre) Mock Test

questions.question: Syllogisms: All cars are trucks. All trucks are vehicles.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: Both Conclusion I and II follow
questions.hint: Conclusion I: All cars are vehicles. Conclusion II: Some vehicles are trucks.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some pens are books. All books are pencils.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Intersection of pens and books falls inside pencils.

questions.question: Syllogisms: No cat is dog. All dogs are lions.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Dogs are inside lions and outside cats.

questions.question: Syllogisms: All apples are fruits. Some fruits are sweet.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows conclusively
questions.hint: No direct link between apples and sweet.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Only a few doors are windows. All windows are walls.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: 'Only a few' implies both some are and some are not.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some doctors are engineers. All engineers are scientists. No scientist is pilot.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: No doctor is pilot is a possibility
questions.hint: No engineer is pilot, but doctors can overlap.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Statements: All A are B. No B is C. All C are D.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: C ⊂ D and C ∩ B = Ø.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Statements: Some red are blue. Some blue are green. Some green are yellow.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: None of the universal conclusions follow
questions.hint: Chain of 'Some' yields no universal relation.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Statements: All rain is water. No water is fire. Some fire is smoke.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Smoke that is fire cannot be water.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Statements: Only a few books are papers. No paper is pen.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Books that are papers cannot be pens.

questions.question: Syllogisms: All shirts are pants. All pants are shoes.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Transitive relation.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some birds are insects. All insects are butterflies.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Overlap extends to butterflies.

questions.question: Syllogisms: No river is ocean. All oceans are seas.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Oceans are inside seas and outside rivers.

questions.question: Syllogisms: All men are mortal. Socrates is a man.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Classic Aristotelian syllogism.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some stars are planets. No planet is moon.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Stars that are planets cannot be moons.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Only a few mobile are laptop. All laptop are computer.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: 'Only a few' guarantees intersection.

questions.question: Syllogisms: All metals are solids. All solids are hard.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Transitive.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some teachers are scholars. Some scholars are authors.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Two 'Some' statements yield no universal link.

questions.question: Syllogisms: No student is lazy. All lazy are failing.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Lazy individuals are outside students.

questions.question: Syllogisms: All trees are plants. No plant is animal.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Trees are inside plants, plants disjoint from animals.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some dogs are friendly. All friendly creatures are loyal.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Overlap.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Only a few chairs are tables. No table is desk.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Chairs that are tables cannot be desks.

questions.question: Syllogisms: All fruits are healthy. All healthy foods are organic.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Transitive.

questions.question: Syllogisms: Some books are novels. No novel is comic.. Which conclusion logically follows?
questions.hint: Books that are novels cannot be comics.

questions.question: Syllogisms: All rivers are water bodies. All water bodies contain water.. Which conclusion logically follows?
options: Some rivers do not contain water
questions.hint: Transitive.

questions.question: Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution specifies the 22 officially recognized languages of India?
questions.hint: Eighth Schedule lists the 22 recognized languages of India.

questions.question: Which prominent Indus Valley Civilization site located in Gujarat is famous for possessing the world's earliest known artificial brick dockyard?
questions.hint: Lothal in Gujarat featured an ancient tidal dockyard.

questions.question: Which Fundamental Rights guaranteed by the Indian Constitution cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency declared under Article 352?
questions.hint: Articles 20 and 21 cannot be suspended during National Emergency.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak situated entirely within the territorial boundaries of India?
questions.hint: Kangchenjunga (8,586 m) is the highest peak entirely within Indian territory.

questions.question: Who founded the Arya Samaj in 1875 and gave the famous slogan 'Back to the Vedas'?
questions.hint: Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded Arya Samaj with the slogan 'Back to the Vedas'.

questions.question: Through how many Indian states does the Tropic of Cancer pass?
questions.hint: The Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 Indian States.

questions.question: In the historical Battle of Plassey (1757), Robert Clive defeated which Nawab of Bengal to lay the foundation of British rule in India?
questions.hint: Robert Clive defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah in the Battle of Plassey (1757).

questions.question: Who serves as the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (Council of States) in the Indian Parliament?
questions.hint: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: Which type of soil, formed from basalt lava and known for high moisture retention, is most suitable for cotton cultivation in India?
questions.hint: Black Regur Soil is ideal for moisture retention and cotton crops.

questions.question: Following the 104th Constitutional Amendment Act which abolished nominated Anglo-Indian seats, what is the maximum sanctioned strength of the Lok Sabha?
questions.hint: Maximum sanctioned strength of Lok Sabha after 104th Amendment is 550 Members.

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution grants the Right to Constitutional Remedies, referred to by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution?
questions.hint: Article 32 guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies.

questions.question: Which Viceroy of India was responsible for the Partition of Bengal in 1905, triggering the Swadeshi Movement?
questions.hint: Lord Curzon partitioned Bengal in 1905.

questions.question: Which river is known as 'Dakshin Ganga' and is the longest peninsular river in India?
questions.hint: Godavari River is the longest peninsular river in India, often called Dakshin Ganga.

questions.question: Who serves as the ex-officio Chairman of the 6-member Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) in India?
options: Governor of Reserve Bank of India
questions.hint: The RBI Governor is the ex-officio Chairman of the Monetary Policy Committee.

questions.question: Which Constitutional Amendment Act introduced the Goods and Services Tax (GST) across India?
questions.hint: The 101st Amendment Act, 2016 introduced Goods and Services Tax (GST).

questions.question: Which Constitutional Amendment Act added the terms 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution?
questions.hint: The 42nd Amendment Act (1976) added Socialist, Secular, and Integrity to the Preamble.

questions.question: Kaziranga National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for preserving two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses, is located in which Indian state?
questions.hint: Kaziranga National Park is located in Assam.

questions.question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the Finance Commission constituted by the President every five years to allocate tax revenues between the Union and States?
questions.hint: Article 280 provides for the constitution of the Finance Commission.

questions.question: Who presided over the 1929 Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress where the historic resolution for 'Purna Swaraj' (Complete Independence) was adopted?
questions.hint: Jawaharlal Nehru presided over the 1929 Lahore INC session.

questions.question: What is the minimum age requirement prescribed by the Indian Constitution for election as the President of India?
questions.hint: Minimum age for election as President of India is 35 Years.

questions.question: Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution specifies the 22 officially recognized languages of India?
questions.hint: Eighth Schedule lists the 22 recognized languages of India.

questions.question: Which prominent Indus Valley Civilization site located in Gujarat is famous for possessing the world's earliest known artificial brick dockyard?
questions.hint: Lothal in Gujarat featured an ancient tidal dockyard.

questions.question: Which Fundamental Rights guaranteed by the Indian Constitution cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency declared under Article 352?
questions.hint: Articles 20 and 21 cannot be suspended during National Emergency.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak situated entirely within the territorial boundaries of India?
questions.hint: Kangchenjunga (8,586 m) is the highest peak entirely within Indian territory.

questions.question: Who founded the Arya Samaj in 1875 and gave the famous slogan 'Back to the Vedas'?
questions.hint: Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded Arya Samaj with the slogan 'Back to the Vedas'.
